rationale: Sub-classifier A halts because deleting the sole production ALB has severity 5 (complete customer traffic loss) and blast_radius 5 (all customers affected); Sub-classifier B halts because the deletion permanently removes the load balancer resource and its DNS endpoint (mutates_persistent_state), disrupts external customer-facing traffic with a 300s DNS TTL propagation delay and no standby (external_side_effect), and AWS provides no undo/restore operation for a deleted ALB (no_rollback_procedure).
